extra.description: 人-物交互检测(Human-Object Interaction,HOI)在视觉场景理解中起着至关重要的作用,随着深度学习技术的发展,基于视觉的交互检测模型已经能够获得良好的性能。然而,现有方法大多缺乏对先验的逻辑知识的运用,有时会推导出不合理的结果。其次,一些方法将空间信息和人体姿态信息用于推理,但它们仅在推理结果和标注之间构造损失,导致解码器无法学习到准确的隐含关系。因此,提出一种利用先验知识增强现有人-物交互检测算法的方法PKHOI,该方法能够有效增强现有人-物交互检测算法的准确性。具体而言,从训练集中构建了一个包含物品功能性、空间关系、人体姿态和动词共现的逻辑规则表,将其形式化为一阶逻辑并映射到连续空间中,在训练阶段和推理阶段分别以损失函数和矩阵乘法的形式将先验的逻辑规则融入神经网络,提升模型的准确性。此外,提出一种通过融合多模态信息(空间、语义和人体姿态信息)生成人-物对查询的方法,结合逻辑损失函数,可以引导解码器学习到更多的隐含知识。利用提出的方法增强了两个主流的人-物交互检测算法UPT和PViC,并在V-COCO,HICO-DET和Flickr30k数据集上进行了评估,实验结果表明,提出的方法可以有效提高现有方法的性能。

items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
items.title_zh: 更多基因，更快推理：从组织学高效预测大面板空间转录组
items.summary_zh: 从组织学预测空间转录组（ST）旨在直接从组织图像推断空间分辨的基因表达谱。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，目前通常用复杂的模型架构、额外输入和复杂的训练流程来解决，同时仍局限于固定的小基因面板。这引出一个自然的问题：是否存在一种高效的大面板 ST 预测方法？在此，我们提出 GeneFlow，一个更简单却有效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配生成建模与结构化多模态融合统一起来。具体而言，GeneFlow 首先通过组织学和基因分词器在空间点上编码组织学形态和跨基因相互作用。该模型直接预测空间基因表达，而非中间速度场，同时以基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练。我们表明，即使不依赖重型生成流程，GeneFlow 在多个 ST 基准上也达到最先进性能，在 1000 基因预测中提升高达 56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow 产生具有生物学意义的点谱，同时将计算成本降低数个数量级，从而提高效率和可

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.summary_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变和形态发生。虽然时间分辨空间转录组学同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同的细胞，留下中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观察。在我们相互作用的平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出了stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一个连续时间生成框架，从非匹配的时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释的算子：细胞内在程序、局部图差分注意力算子（在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何），以及非局部平均场注意力算子（捕捉超出紧邻邻域的远程群体背景）。通过随细胞迁移一起演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移和相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND通过联合表达-位置空间中的最优传输解析尺度特异性细胞间影响。在蝾螈和斑马鱼基准中，st

extra.description: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: PDO Drug Screening Data for Evaluating and Training AI Drug Response Prediction Models
items.title_zh: 用于评估和训练AI药物反应预测模型的PDO药物筛选数据
items.summary_zh: 抗癌药物反应预测（DRP）对于精准肿瘤学和治疗开发至关重要。目前，大多数DRP模型是使用永生化癌细胞系的药物筛选数据开发的，这些数据在基因组和分子水平上可能与患者肿瘤存在显著差异，尽管患者肿瘤反应是最终的预测目标。为帮助弥合这一差距并使DRP模型更接近其预期的临床应用，我们使用患者来源类器官（PDO）进行了四项药物筛选研究，PDO比永生化细胞系更忠实地再现患者肿瘤。这些研究产生了用于改进和评估DRP模型的数据，包括PDO系的多组学图谱、药物特征数据和治疗反应测量。利用这些数据，我们在三种模型构建场景下重新训练和评估了多个公开可用的DRP模型：仅使用细胞系数据训练模型、使用细胞系和PDO联合数据训练模型、以及在细胞系数据上预训练模型后在PDO数据上微调。然后我们在这些分析场景中评估和比较了模型在PDO上的预测性能。此外，我们还评估了不同实验室使用不同检测技术和/或实验方案生成的药物筛选活力数

extra.description: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
items.title_zh: 在仿真中训练推理模型以原生使用真实机器人
items.summary_zh: 机器人使用智能体（RUA）已成为通用机器人控制的一种有前景的方法。然而，迄今只有 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2 等前沿专有模型取得了强劲性能，而开放权重模型的能力仍明显较弱。我们表明，一个开放权重的 27B 推理模型可以通过强化学习完全在仿真中、无需演示地训练，以原生使用真实机器人。与计算机使用智能体（CUA）一样，该模型观察环境、进行思维链推理并生成下一个末端执行器位姿，无需任何外部框架。我们构建了智能体机器人后训练引擎（PEAR），并用它通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）大规模训练模型完成仿真机器人任务，模仿前沿模型获得计算机使用能力的方式。我们发现，在仿真中获得的技能能很好地泛化到训练任务之外：它们迁移到未见过的机器人、真实世界和新指令。在仿真中对 LIBERO 和 RoboDojo 训练后，该模型在真实双臂机器人上 60% 的试验中成功，而基础模型一

extra.description: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $π_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.

items.title: BAL: Bidirectional Autoregression in Latent Space for Learning Human Movement Representations
items.title_zh: BAL：潜在空间中的双向自回归用于学习人体运动表示
items.summary_zh: 从 3D 姿态序列学习语义有意义的人体运动表示对于人类行为建模至关重要。现有的自监督方法从人工假设中获取监督，例如在一定范围内对增强的不变性或在一定时间尺度上对掩码区域的可恢复性，引入了启发式超参数，使学到的语义对其设置敏感。我们提出 BAL，一个自监督框架，转而利用人体运动内在的监督：日常行为的自然顺序结构。BAL 在语义抽象的潜在空间中自回归预测，类似于人类预测他人动作而非其精确关节配置的方式。双向自回归预测，在时间上向前和向后，充分利用这些顺序约束，同时在推理时能够使用过去和未来上下文提取表示。为抑制表示坍缩，BAL 将每个预测目标分解为捕获序列级语义的全局分量和捕获上下文无关运动的局部分量。我们证明，除非表示完全坍缩，局部目标保留非平凡的角度多样性，从而保持有意义的训练信号。在大规模数据集上的实验表明，BAL 的表示对运动描述、预测和插值非常有效，在大多数评估指标上优于基线。

extra.description: Learning semantically meaningful human movement representations from 3D pose sequences is essential for human behavior modeling. Existing self-supervised methods derive supervision from artificial assumptions, e.g., invariance to augmentation within a certain range or recoverability of masked regions at a certain temporal scale, introducing heuristic hyperparameters that make the learned semantics sensitive to their settings. We propose BAL, a self-supervised framework that instead exploits supervision intrinsic to human movement: the natural ordering structure of everyday behavior. BAL autoregressively predicts in a semantically abstract latent space, analogous to how humans anticipate others' actions rather than their precise joint configurations. Bidirectional autoregressive prediction, both forward and backward in time, fully leverages these ordering constraints while enabling representation extraction using both past and future context at inference. To suppress representation collapse, BAL decomposes each prediction target into a global component capturing sequence-level semantics and a local component capturing context-independent movement. We prove that the local targets retain nontrivial angular diversity unless the representations are completely collapsed, preserving a meaningful training signal. Experiments on large-scale datasets demonstrate that BAL's representations are highly effective for motion captioning, forecasting, and interpolation, outperforming baselines on most evaluation metrics.

items.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
items.title_zh: WeightBench：评估语言模型作为权重空间程序员
items.summary_zh: 近期工作表明，大型语言模型（LLM）可以直接操作其他神经网络的参数。它们可以读取网络被训练来做什么、修复失败的网路、从零编写可工作的网络，全部无需梯度下降。这种能力被称为权重空间编程（WSP）。系统地探索这一新范式需要一个稳健的基准。我们推出 WEIGHTBENCH，一个评估能力递增的 LLM 在五个赛道共 42 项 WSP 任务上的基准：读取、修复和编写权重，识别不可能的编辑，以及无数据压缩。LLM 读取和编辑权重的网络范围从 2K 参数的控制策略到 7B 参数的语言模型。实验基准结果表明，前沿智能体已经可以读取小型网络并编写可工作的控制策略而无需运行它们，但尚不能修补语言模型、无数据压缩它们，或区分不可能编辑和困难编辑。在所有 42 项任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 达到宏观分数 0.535（Sonnet 5.5 0.466，Haiku 5.5 0.402，DeepSeek v

extra.description: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus's 0.546. Code, the task registry, our OS-level sandbox harness, and the live leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench.

items.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 模仿引导的多智能体强化学习
items.summary_zh: 演示是加速单智能体强化学习（RL）的有效方法，但将这一想法扩展到多智能体强化学习（MARL）并非易事，因为单人同时遥操作多个智能体困难且往往不可能。轮转行为克隆（R2BC）通过让单个演示者一次控制一个智能体，而其他智能体执行其当前策略来解决这个问题。然而，由此产生的模仿策略受演示质量限制。我们提出模仿引导的多智能体强化学习（IBMARL），一个将模仿引导强化学习（IBRL）扩展到协作团队并使用 R2BC 训练模仿策略的框架。在每个时间步，每个智能体从模仿策略和 RL 策略各获得一个动作提议，一个集中式评论家集成在两者的每智能体组合中进行选择。门控模仿惩罚，一种软 Q 过滤的行为克隆损失，仅在评论家更看重模仿动作的地方将每个 RL 策略正则化向其模仿策略，以便训练后每个智能体单独执行其 RL 策略，无需集中式评论家。在四个协作多智能体 RL 基准上，IBMARL 在两个任务上比基于演示的基线

extra.description: Demonstrations are an effective way to accelerate single-agent reinforcement learning (RL), but extending this idea to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is non-trivial as it is difficult and often impossible for a single person to teleoperate multiple agents simultaneously. Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC) addresses this by letting a single demonstrator control one agent at a time while the others execute their current policies. However, the resulting imitation policies are limited by the quality of the demonstrations. We propose Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (IBMARL), a framework that extends Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning (IBRL) to cooperative teams and uses R2BC to train the imitation policies. At each time step, every agent receives one action proposal from its imitation policy and one from its RL policy, and an ensemble of centralized critics selects among the per-agent combinations of the two. A gated imitation penalty, a soft Q-filtered behavior cloning loss, regularizes each RL policy toward its imitation policy only where the critics value the imitation action more, so that after training each agent executes its RL policy alone, without the centralized critics. On four cooperative multi-agent RL benchmarks, IBMARL surpasses its imitation policies $2.6$-$4.2\times$ faster than demonstration-based baselines on two tasks, is the only method to surpass it on the other two, and exceeds the demonstrator itself on two of the four. With real human demonstrations IBMARL still surpasses imitation learning alone, and does so more than twice as fast as the best baseline.

items.title: Elliptic Sampling: Optimal Interpolant Schedules for Gaussians and Beyond
items.title_zh: 椭圆采样：高斯及更一般分布的最优插值调度
items.summary_zh: 基于随机插值的生成建模需要指定两个关键选择：桥接初始和目标分布的插值调度，以及由此产生的概率流 ODE 的高效离散化。在这项工作中，我们引入一个基于（复化）ODE 轨迹解析性质的联合调度/离散化设计新框架，这反过来确保良好的数值行为。我们的公式可以通过共形映射精确求解，产生一个自然的保方差椭圆调度族，由 Jacobi 椭圆函数参数化。将椭圆调度与定制离散化配对，我们得到 Zoloflow，一种与 Zolotarev 最优有理函数逼近密切相关的新的采样算法。关键的是，椭圆调度和 Zoloflow 都明确纳入目标分布的条件数 $κ$，并在 $κ\rightarrow 1$ 的极限下退化为经典三角调度。对于高斯目标，Zoloflow 在所有 oblivious score-span 算法中达到极小极大最优性，使用 $Θ(\logκ\,\log(\sqrt d/\varepsilon))$（精确）

extra.description: Generative modeling based on stochastic interpolants requires specifying two key choices: an interpolant schedule bridging the initial and target distributions, and an efficient discretization of the resulting probability-flow ODE. In this work, we introduce a new framework for joint schedule/discretization design based on the analyticity properties of the (complexified) ODE trajectories, which in turn ensure good numerical behavior. Our formulation can be solved exactly via conformal mapping, yielding a natural family of variance-preserving elliptic schedules, parametrized by Jacobi elliptic functions. Pairing an elliptic schedule with a tailored discretization, we obtain Zoloflow, a new sampling algorithm closely connected to Zolotarev's optimal rational function approximants. Crucially, both the elliptic schedule and Zoloflow explicitly incorporate the condition number $κ$ of the target distribution and reduce to the classical trig schedule in the limit $κ\rightarrow 1$. For Gaussian targets, Zoloflow achieves minimax optimality among all oblivious score-span algorithms, attaining total-variation error $\varepsilon$ using $Θ(\logκ\,\log(\sqrt d/\varepsilon))$ (exact) score queries. For the log-concave case, the elliptic schedule allows sampling with at most $\varepsilon$ 2-Wasserstein-error by requiring merely $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d} \, \mathrm{polylog}(κ, 1/\varepsilon))$ score evaluations. Complementing these theoretical results, we empirically evaluate the elliptic schedule on general (non-log-concave) target distributions, including detailed comparisons with alternative schedule proposals on both synthetic benchmarks and existing image generation datasets.

items.title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
items.title_zh: StreamEmbed：从像素实时索引用于截图检索
items.summary_zh: 屏幕历史可以作为人和智能体可搜索的视觉记忆，但与离线语料库不同，它必须在每张截图到达时进行编码和索引。基于OCR的索引速度快但丢失视觉信息；视觉编码耗时超过两秒。然而屏幕是增量变化的：大多数像素在截图内部和截图之间重复。这引出一个问题：视觉编码器是否需要为每张新截图从头重新计算其表示？我们提出StreamEmbed，一个利用这种冗余进行增量视觉嵌入的系统。仅由像素差异引导，它结合了空间token剪枝（跳过与邻居重复的块）和时间KV复用（对跨截图未变化的块复用缓存的键和值）。一个小型学习适配器补偿剪枝和复用，以保持与完整截图嵌入的保真度。在ScreenMemEval（我们的基准，包含来自两个人和一个计算机使用智能体的184小时屏幕历史中的10,426个问题）上，StreamEmbed在M2 Pro GPU上设定了新的准确率-延迟帕累托前沿：编码速度比完整截图编码快达3.7倍而不牺牲准确率，并

extra.description: Screen history can serve as searchable visual memory for people and agents, but unlike an offline corpus, it must be encoded and indexed as each screenshot arrives. OCR-based indexing is fast but loses visual information; visual encoding takes over two seconds. Yet screens change incrementally: most pixels repeat within and across screenshots. This raises a question: do visual encoders need to recompute their representations from scratch for every new screenshot? We present StreamEmbed, a system for incremental visual embedding that exploits this redundancy. Guided solely by pixel differences, it combines spatial token pruning, which skips blocks that repeat a neighbor, with temporal KV reuse, which reuses cached keys and values for blocks unchanged across screenshots. A small learned adapter compensates for pruning and reuse to preserve fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval, our benchmark of 10,426 questions over 184 hours of screen histories from two humans and a computer-use agent, StreamEmbed sets a new accuracy-latency Pareto frontier on an M2 Pro GPU: it encodes up to 3.7x faster than full-screenshot encoding without sacrificing accuracy and improves accuracy over OCR-based indexing by up to 6.3 Recall@10 points at matched latency. A memory-efficient vector index stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM. Together, these results make real-time indexing of screen history in its native visual form practical, laying a foundation for fully local visual assistants.

items.title: Endogenous expression of mutant RagC in mice results in early-onset dilated cardiomyopathy with features of the Long-Olsen-Distelmaier syndrome
items.title_zh: 小鼠体内突变RagC的内源性表达导致早发性扩张型心肌病，具有Long-Olsen-Distelmaier综合征的特征
items.summary_zh: 扩张型心肌病（DCM）是一种严重的心脏疾病，常与心律失常、血栓和心力衰竭相关，目前治疗尚无法治愈。最近，在编码Rag GTPase营养信号通路组分的基因中，特别是RRAGC，发现了新生突变，存在于无关的患有严重早发性DCM综合征（称为Long-Olsen-Distelmaier）的患者中。癌细胞系、hiPSC衍生心肌细胞和斑马鱼已被用于研究这种Ragopathy，但尚未生成用于研究该综合征的哺乳动物模型。在这里，我们展示经过工程改造以在内源性表达丝氨酸74突变（对应于患者中突变的丝氨酸75）的小鼠，表现出早发性DCM特征，包括心脏尺寸减小、纤维化、舒张功能障碍和主动脉瓣关闭不全，这些特征让人联想到人类综合征。此外，Rragc突变心脏显示左心室质量和室间隔减小。Rragc突变变体的内源性杂合表达导致较温和的、亚致死的生理性心脏生长缺陷，伴有收缩压和舒张压升高。机制上，活性RagC不会导致心肌

extra.description: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a severe heart condition often linked to arrhythmias, clots, and heart failure, for which treatments are not yet curative. Recently, de novo mutations in genes encoding components of the Rag GTPase nutrient signaling pathway, particularly in RRAGC, have been found in unrelated patients with a severe, early-onset DCM syndrome called Long-Olsen-Distelmaier. Cancer cell lines, hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes and zebrafish have been used to study this Ragopathy, but a mammalian model to investigate this syndrome has not been generated. Here, we show that mice engineered to endogenously express mutations in Serine 74 (orthologous to the Serine 75 mutated in patients), exhibit early-onset features of DCM with decreased heart size, fibrosis, diastolic dysfunction and aortic insufficiency, characteristics reminiscent of the human syndrome. Moreover, Rragc-mutant hearts display decreased left ventricular mass and interventricular septum. Endogenous heterozygous expression of Rragc mutant variants result in a milder, sublethal defective physiological cardiac growth with increased systolic and diastolic blood pressure. Mechanistically, active RagC does not cause abnormal increase in cardiomyocyte size, but leads to suppressed transcriptional activity of Tfeb and alterations in cardiomyocyte metabolism. Transcriptional profiling of neonatal mutant hearts reveals multiple signatures of impaired mitochondrial activity. Ex vivo and in vitro analyses of murine cardiomyocyte mitochondria from Rragc-mutant mice show suppressed mitochondrial respiration, disturbed complex IV multimerization and super-complex organization. These data point to abnormal early postnatal heart metabolism by deregulated nutrient - Rag GTPase signaling with a potential molecular explanation to the early onset of DCM in patients with de novo missense mutations in RRAGC, and suggests the relevance of early metabolic interventions in conditions with altered nutrient signaling

items.title: Analyzing epigenetic modifications at sample-specific CpG loci in long-read data using a likelihood-based framework in bsseq.
items.title_zh: 在bsseq中使用基于似然的框架分析长读长数据中样本特异性CpG位点的表观遗传修饰。
items.summary_zh: 脊椎动物基因组中CpG背景下的DNA常发生表观遗传修饰，这增加了其突变率。然而，识别样本特异性CpG位点以分析表观遗传修饰仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出一种基于读长的似然框架，用于在Nanopore和PacBio平台的单分子长读长测序数据中高精度和高灵敏度地识别参考和非参考CpG位点。纳入所有样本特异性CpG位点增加了可分析位点数量并减少了修饰水平估计中的偏差，这两个因素对准确分析表观遗传修饰至关重要。该似然框架在R包bsseq中实现，源代码可在github https://github.com/hansenlab/bsseq获取。长读长分析和基于似然的CpG位点过滤的安装说明和用户指南可在Bioconductor https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/bsseq.html获取。补充数据可在Bioinformatics在

extra.description: DNA in CpG context is often epigenetically modified in vertebrate genomes which increases their mutation rate. However, it remains challenging to identify sample-specific CpG loci for analysis of epigenetic modifications. Here, we present a read-based likelihood framework for identifying reference and non-reference CpG loci with high precision and sensitivity in single-molecule long-read sequencing data from Nanopore and PacBio platforms. Including all sample-specific CpG loci increases the number of analyzable loci and reduces bias in modification level estimates, both critical factors for accurate analyses of epigenetic modifications. The likelihood framework is implemented in the R package bsseq with the source code available on github https://github.com/hansenlab/bsseq. Installation instructions and a user guide for long-read analysis and likelihood-based filtering of CpG loci are available on Bioconductor https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/bsseq.html. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Integer quantized multilayer perceptron neural network for lossless compression of nanopore signal.
items.title_zh: 用于纳米孔信号无损压缩的整数量化多层感知器神经网络。
items.summary_zh: 纳米孔测序对于高级基因组分析不可或缺，但原始信号输出产生了巨大的存储和带宽需求。已提出VBZ和ex-zd等专用无模型压缩器来应对这一挑战。它们提供高吞吐量和强压缩性能，但无法充分利用高阶统计依赖性，这限制了进一步收益。基于学习的压缩器可实现更好的压缩比，但通常引入浮点非确定性且对于大规模纳米孔数据集太慢，降低了其实用性。我们介绍SigComp，一种用于纳米孔信号数据的学习型无损压缩器。SigComp采用紧凑的多层感知器网络，具有固定上下文窗口，以捕获主导的单字节信号增量中的高阶依赖性。通过集成训练后量化和完全GPU原生的范围编码器，SigComp消除了自回归编码循环中的GPU-CPU同步开销，同时确保跨不同执行设置的严格位精确性。在不同物种和测序化学（DNA R10.4.1和RNA004）上的评估表明，SigComp相比VBZ和ex-zd分别持续将压缩文件大小减少6.00%-7.09%和3

extra.description: Nanopore sequencing is indispensable for advanced genomic analyses, but the raw signal output creates substantial storage and bandwidth demands. Specialized model-free compressors such as VBZ and ex-zd have been proposed to address this challenge. They deliver high throughput and strong compression performance, yet they cannot fully exploit higher-order statistical dependencies, which limits further gains. Learning-based compressors can achieve better compression ratios, but they often introduce floating-point non-determinism and are too slow for large-scale nanopore datasets, reducing their practicality. We introduce SigComp, a learned lossless compressor for nanopore signal data. SigComp employs a compact multilayer perceptron network with a fixed context window to capture higher-order dependencies within the dominant one-byte signal deltas. By integrating post-training quantization and a fully GPU-native range coder, SigComp eliminates GPU-CPU synchronization overhead in the autoregressive coding loop while ensuring strict bit-exactness across diverse execution settings. Evaluations on diverse species and sequencing chemistries (DNA R10.4.1 and RNA004) demonstrate that SigComp consistently reduces compressed file sizes by 6.00%-7.09% and 3.86%-5.34% over VBZ and ex-zd, respectively, albeit with a 10× lower processing throughput. Compared to the leading neural compressor, SigComp achieves a comparable compression ratio, sacrificing merely 0.4%-1.9%, while delivering 46-74× higher throughput. Ablation studies confirm that SigComp's integer-only, GPU-native approach improves throughput by 7.75-8.30× overall over hybrid GPU-CPU pipelines without model quantization, and the default 64-symbol context window effectively captures the vast majority of exploitable redundancy. SigComp can also be extended to lossy compression by eliminating the least significant bits, and achieve compression ratios of 4.047-4.868, outperforming lossy ex-zd by 9.18%-14.38%. Although processing remains slower than specialized codecs, SigComp offers an excellent trade-off for long-term cold archival storage, particularly when scaled via multi-GPU environments. SigComp is freely available on GitHub at: https://github.com/BioinfoSZU/SigComp. It supports CPU-only, NVIDIA, and AMD GPU execution backends with seamless cross-platform archive interoperability, as well as multi-GPU scaling. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: The Biodiversity Cell Atlas database: a curated resource for comparative single-cell genomics across the eukaryotic tree of life.
items.title_zh: 生物多样性细胞图谱数据库：一个用于真核生命树比较单细胞基因组学的精选资源。
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基因组学改变了细胞多样性研究，但由此产生的图谱分散在出版物、格式和注释标准中。使其可查找和互操作的努力主要集中于聚合和协调现有模式生物数据集。生物多样性细胞图谱数据库是一个开放资源，通过统一（重新）处理、精选和比较跨真核生命树采样的全生物体单细胞图谱来弥补这一差距。从原始测序数据开始，每个数据集通过一致的工作流处理，并 enriched 标准化质量控制指标、元细胞级聚合、基因共表达模块以及基于系统发育的直系同源和功能注释，使得物种内以基因和细胞类型为中心的探索以及物种间有原则的比较成为可能。该门户目前托管来自13个真核门33个物种的39个数据集，并提供多级访问，从原始和过滤计数矩阵到标准化、聚合和分析就绪的数据层。这些可通过交互式网络界面（https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org）和文档化的REST API（https://portal.bio

extra.description: Single-cell genomics has transformed the study of cellular diversity, but the resulting atlases are scattered across publications, formats, and annotation standards. Efforts to make these data findable and interoperable have focused largely on aggregating and harmonizing existing model organism datasets. The Biodiversity Cell Atlas database is an open resource that addresses this gap by uniformly (re)processing, curating, and comparing whole-organism single-cell atlases sampled across the eukaryotic tree of life. Starting from raw sequencing data, each dataset is processed through a consistent workflow and enriched with standardized quality-control metrics, metacell-level aggregation, gene co-expression modules, and phylogeny-based orthology and functional annotation, enabling both gene- and cell type-centric exploration within species as well as principled comparisons between them. The portal currently hosts 39 datasets across 33 species spanning 13 eukaryotic phyla, and offers multiple levels of access, from raw and filtered count matrices to normalized, aggregated, and analysis-ready data layers. These are accessible through an interactive web interface (https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org) and a documented REST API (https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org/api/v1/). All data, code, and infrastructure are continuously released and maintained under open licenses, providing a curated and reusable foundation for comparative single-cell genomics.

items.title: 闲鱼称被叫「暗网」系污名化，已起诉「拐卖儿童暗语」谣言造谣者并索赔 100 万元，怎样从法律角度解读？
items.title_zh: 闲鱼称被叫「暗网」系污名化，已起诉「拐卖儿童暗语」谣言造谣者并索赔 100 万元，怎样从法律角度解读？
items.summary_zh: 闲鱼11月16日发文称，今年10月初，社交平台流传所谓“拐卖儿童暗语”谣言，污名化闲鱼为“暗网”，闲鱼发现后立即对谣言存证。经调查，赵某某在短视频平台评论区，将普通交易对话歪曲解读为“拐卖儿童暗语”，相关谣言被迅速转发并登上热搜，引发大量网友的恐慌。 闲鱼表示，赵某某制造的谣言引发数十万网友产生误解，但其发布的辟谣致歉内容却零关注。谣言严重干扰了闲鱼平台正常商品交易秩序，对平台声誉造成难以挽回的深远伤害。闲鱼正式对造谣人侵害企业名誉权的行为提起民事诉讼，索赔100万元，后续将陆续起诉其他造谣者。 相关报道： 闲鱼发布情况通报 11月16日，闲鱼通报： 2026年8月以来，我们发现网络空间流传“拐卖儿童暗语”、“偷窃A4纸出售”、“农产品涉色情交易”、“钓鱼竿涉色情交易”等大量不实信息，污名化闲鱼为“暗网”。闲鱼立即向造谣人所在地报警，相关信息经调查，均为谣言。 谣言严重干扰了平台正常交易秩

items.title_zh: 美国 ULA 成立 20 年来首次发射任务完全失败，「火神」火箭升空十分钟后异常，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，美国联合发射联盟公司（ULA）的Amazon Leo 的首次发射任务。 不过，火箭升空约 10 分钟后出现异常，未能将搭载的 40 颗卫星送入预定轨道。这是 ULA 自 2006 年成立以来首次发射任务完全失败，终结了该公司近 20 年的全胜纪录。 北京时间 11 月 16 日凌晨，火神火箭从卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地 SLC-41 发射升空，执行代号为 LV-01 的任务。美国联合发射联盟随后发表声明称，根据发射主管收到的数据，火箭在飞行约 10 分钟后出现异常，未能将亚马逊的卫星送入轨道。 ULA 表示，异常发生后，公司暂时没有足够的数据判断具体原因，将与客户及其他相关机构合作开展调查，确定根本原因并制定纠正措施，之后再恢复发射。路透社报道称，此次事故造成火箭及其搭载的 40 颗卫星损失，具体故障原因尚不明确。 ULA 表示，异常发生后，公司暂时没有足够的

items.title: 上海集中涌现「个人学校」，采用小班、一人一课表和专属导师制，究竟是模式创新，还是传统脱产班换了个包装？
items.title_zh: 上海集中涌现「个人学校」，采用小班、一人一课表和专属导师制，究竟是模式创新，还是传统脱产班换了个包装？
items.summary_zh: 你也许没想到，现在在上海“选个好学校、读个国际课程、然后等着升学的传统路径”已经在发生改变。 上海的国际教育圈，开始冒出了一批“个人学校”或者叫“个性化学习中心”。 简单来说，“个人学校”并不是一所“学校”，而是一种定制化教育模式。它的核心理念是因材施教，把传统“学生适应学校”的逻辑，翻转为“学校适配学生”。 大致表现为这些特征： 超小班教学：主流班级规模在3-10人之间，有的甚至做到1对1。 一人一课表：课程、进度、考试局均可根据学生能力与目标量身定制。 专属导师制：每位学生配备责任导师，全程负责学业规划、升学指导、心理疏导和家校沟通。 听上去很不错，对吧？ 但冷静下来想一想：这些扎堆出现的“个人学校”，到底是真正颠覆传统的教育创新，还是把脱产班重新包装一下、换个马甲来收割焦虑的家长？https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1881896588839630162

items.summary_zh: 西班牙足协纪律委员会发布公告，安道尔FC门将奥沃诺因在比赛中使用极度暴力的犯规动作导致特内里费球员德米格尔离世，被处以禁赛12场的顶格处罚，并附带罚款。西乙第12轮特内里费2-2安道尔FC的比赛中，特内里费前锋德米格尔与奥沃诺相撞后心脏骤停失去意识，被紧急送往医院，进入ICU治疗。安道尔FC的门将奥沃诺在此次事件中吃到红牌。北京时间11月3日中午，特内里费官方发布公告称德米格尔神经系统状况恶化，3日下午4点半左右，特内里费确认德米格尔不幸离世。 根据西班牙足协纪律守则第102条（暴力行为）和第52条（罚款），委员会对本起事件进行了裁决。公告指出，尽管没有证据表明球员有主观恶意，但其动作的暴力程度和绝对危险性无可辩驳。无论造成的后果如何，这种行为本身都完全超出了足球比赛的常规。纪律委员会在公告中明确指出，考虑到事件的严重后果以及动作极度危险的性质，必须对该行为予以最严厉的惩处。因此，决定适用

items.title: 浙江多地试点推行「潮汐学校」弹性教育配置模式，怎样看待这一模式？落地需要突破哪些难点？
items.title_zh: 浙江多地试点推行「潮汐学校」弹性教育配置模式，怎样看待这一模式？落地需要突破哪些难点？
items.summary_zh: 目前，杭州萧山区、金华义乌市正加速推进“潮汐学校”这一弹性化教育资源配置新模式的试点，其中义乌已率先落地两所“潮汐学校”并在今年秋季投用。所谓“潮汐学校”，是一种借鉴潮汐涨落规律的新型学校建设模式，其核心在于“集约建设、弹性使用”。学校在规划建设初期即按高标准建设并预留弹性空间，可根据各学段学位需求“排浪式”变动的特点，动态调配学位资源，以应对学龄人口波动带来的学位压力。 例如，在初中入学高峰期间，优先用于满足初中学位需求；待高峰过后，逐步转换为高中学位供给，从而实现“一校两用、灵活适配”。据浙江省教育厅官方微信公众号“教育之江”，在1月上旬召开的2026年全国教育工作会议上，浙江省教育厅党组书记、厅长陈春雷围绕“加强资源前瞻性布局，平稳有序应对基础教育学龄人口渐次达峰”作交流发言时表示，为应对“学前阶段和小学阶段学龄人口已达峰，初中阶段和高中阶段学龄人口仍在持续增加”的学龄人口变化，该省
